outline.subject: Central European University is a private research university with campuses in Vienna and Budapest that focuses on social sciences and humanities.

sections.title: Central European University
sections.covers: This section provides an overview of the university's mission, founding, academic structure, and its relocation from Budapest to Vienna following legal conflicts with the Hungarian government.

sections.title: History
sections.covers: This section details the origins, founding, and development of the university, as well as the legislative and political conflicts that led to its departure from Budapest.
